business_problem: SupPlant works to help farmers optimize irrigation to support stronger crop yields while saving water by optimizing their usage. Using specialized in-field hardware and a proprietary software algorithms, SupPlant gives farmers tailored recommendations to support the real-time needs of crops.
solution_summary: Using IBM technology, we can build trust with local farms and produce reliable leads for agricultural sellers. SupPlant selected IBM watsonx Orchestrate and IBM DataStax Astra DB within IBM watsonx.data as the basis for its new offering, called Plant ;). Building on the sophisticated algorithm and vast datastore SupPlant has developed, Plant ;) uses satellite images of plots to give farmers personalized weather and irrigation information twice a week, as well as ad hoc alerts for extreme weather and plant stress. With IBM DataStax Astra DB, SupPlant automated the ingestion and retrieval of the unstructured data the company gathers from sensors and satellites, enriching it to make it AI-ready.
business_outcome: Founded in 2016, is an agricultural technology company on a mission to save water while improving crop productivity and yield. With around 100 employees in offices across Israel, Morocco, Mexico and other countries, SupPlant works globally to analyze the real-time needs of crops, producing actionable agronomical insights for farmers.
metrics: "Around 90% of the world's farmers are running small-scale operations," begins Lior Naaman, Chief Marketing Officer at SupPlant.
Today, around 50,000 farmers worldwide are using Plant ;), and SupPlant is seeing 500-1,000 new users joining every day.
